title: Dead Air, Sunday 16 February 1997
credit: The original footer reads ‘DEAD AIR / BpT / 16/2/1997’.
summary: The studio running order, from the four o’clock news to the half-past-five ident. The operator had timings, disc and track numbers, instructions for the mics, and warnings about fades and false endings.
editorialNote: Times follow the desk sheet, including the repeated 17:26:30. Adjacent untimed actions are grouped with their cue. Studio instructions are abridged and the spelling of Stina Nordenstam’s name is regularised; it appears two different ways in the file. Contemporary correspondence confirms the broadcast and Eoin’s session. The sheet records how the team meant the programme to run.

entries.title: Start of show
entries.detail: Cue the sound of the team running in late.

entries.title: Popcorn
entries.detail: Shout over the start, then talk over the theme.

entries.title: The Undertones – Teenage Kicks
entries.detail: CD, track 5. Straight in; fade from 2:19.

entries.title: Television – Venus
entries.detail: Whisper over the outgoing fade. Vinyl at 45rpm, side A, track 1; ends at 3:43. Follow with the ‘Yikes!’ hit.

entries.title: Introducing Dead Air, Maxie, and Rufus
entries.detail: Identify the records, preview the programme, and introduce Rufus as the work-experience member of the team.

entries.title: Nick Drake – One of These Things First
entries.detail: Keep the mics up at the start. Bryter Layter, track 4; piano at 0:13.

entries.title: Rufus’s choice
entries.detail: ‘Yo!’ hit, identify the records, then the scripted link.

entries.title: DJ Shadow – Organ Donor
entries.detail: 1:57; follow with the ‘Wait just a minute’ hit.

entries.title: Eoin Quiery
entries.detail: Talk to the musicians. Introduce Eoin’s choice.

entries.title: Stina Nordenstam – Little Star
entries.detail: Romeo + Juliet soundtrack; straight in, 3:36. The disc track number is left as question marks.

entries.title: The Fall – Totally Wired
entries.detail: Station ident and whisper. The Collection, track 13; three seconds of drums.

entries.title: Fraser reads
entries.detail: Klaus Wunderlich’s Happy Hammond underneath. The script calls for the decks to go off in the middle of the reading.

entries.title: Tiger – On The Rose
entries.detail: Keep the mics up. CD, track 1; five seconds of intro, guitars at 0:13.

entries.title: Advertisements, ident, and link
entries.detail: Identify the records; scripted link on interview advice.

entries.title: Eoin Quiery
entries.detail: Second session slot.

entries.title: Caroline Trettine – Be A Devil
entries.detail: After the link, play side one, track one at 45rpm, fade after thirty seconds, then replay at 33rpm. Watch for the false ending.

entries.title: Monaco – What Do You Want From Me?
entries.detail: Three short hits and a link into the record. Five seconds of bass at the start; start talking over the fade at 3:42.

entries.title: Maxie’s trivia slot
entries.detail: Introduce the New Order connection. Meco’s Star Wars Theme/Cantina Band underneath, on vinyl at 45rpm.

entries.title: Popcorn
entries.detail: Batman hit, talk over the theme, and introduce the last half-hour.

entries.title: Aztec Camera – Good Morning Britain
entries.detail: Stray, track 5; guitar and drums, ends at 3:58.

entries.title: Fraser reads
entries.detail: Pretend not to notice the previous record has ended. Joy Division’s Love Will Tear Us Apart is the bed, from Permanent, track 1.

entries.title: Eoin Quiery
entries.detail: A shout into Eoin’s third session slot.

entries.title: Link, advertisements, and ident
entries.detail: Identify the records; scripted ‘Simple Simon’ link.

entries.title: Urusei Yatsura – Strategic Hamlets
entries.detail: Track 1; eight seconds of guitar. No fade. Play the hit at the end.

entries.title: Jonathan Richman – I Was Dancing In The Lesbian Bar
entries.detail: I, Jonathan, track 5. Straight in; ends at 3:39.

entries.title: FA Cup bet
entries.detail: Whisper hit, identify the tracks, then the FA Cup link.

entries.title: Dancing Queen
entries.detail: The desk sheet gives this mix the same start time as the preceding link.

entries.title: Popcorn
entries.detail: Talk over the closing theme.

entries.title: End of show
entries.detail: ‘We’re not live now are we?’
